rec.name: PDP Gallery Image Info Bar ("More info" Band with Popover)
rec.status: Built — launched (styling iterated; final version approved 2025-04-10)

what.text: A full-width info band under each product gallery image. The left-aligned slide title (e.g. "Test") is bold. On the right sit a small underlined "Mehr info" (More info) link and a round black info icon with a white "i". Clicking it opens a white popover above the bar, with a small arrow pointing at the link, showing extra explanatory content for that image. The magnifier (zoom) icon is placed top-left on desktop and mobile. The gallery also has a round video thumbnail at the top right, and a white round prev/next arrow button.

why.text: Gallery images often can't explain details such as materials, dimensions, features or personalization. A contextual "More info" affordance next to the image answers questions at the moment of interest without cluttering the image or pushing the page down. This reduces uncertainty and lowers the cognitive load of hunting through the description. The universally recognised black "i" icon signals optional help. A calm, low-contrast band keeps it visible but not distracting.

how.text: Add a per-slide info block to the PDP media gallery, rendered as a full-width strip directly below the image. The strip contains the title, left-aligned, and a right-aligned trigger consisting of an underlined "Mehr info" text and a circular black icon with a white "i". The trigger toggles a white popover anchored above the bar with a small caret pointing to the trigger. Ticket history: first version used background #dde7ff, and the screenshots show the light-blue band. The client later asked for a white and narrower band (the final reference is not in the screenshots, so the final look is unconfirmed). Move the zoom magnifier to the top-left on both desktop and mobile. Content for title and popover should come from per-image/per-product fields.

items: Band background color (initially #dde7ff, later requested white)
Zoom icon position (top-left, desktop and mobile)

dependencies.text: Gallery theme with custom media slides. The source doesn't specify where title and popover content are stored; presumably image/product metafields or block settings. The video thumbnail and zoom features are already in the theme (visible in the screenshots).

items: Conversion rate for products with vs. without info bars
Scroll depth and time on PDP

images.caption: Initial full-width light-blue band under the image: bold left-aligned title, small "Mehr info" link and black round info icon at right; arrow button at left.
Refined version with a narrower band, open white popover with caret pointing to "Mehr info", and zoom magnifier at top-left.
